name: Ostkustleden Etapp 4, Krokstorp - Mörtfors
description: Krokstorp to Mörtfors. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Naturkartan page/API says 17.4 km, PDF and OSM tag say 17.5 km, Döderhult says cirka 18 km, and OSM/Pacer computed linework is about 16.332 km.
Naturkartan section page/site pin 57.4573952970922, 16.459728608256 lies at a mid-route track junction, not at Krokstorp.
The official GPX is authoritative but raw track order is unusable and would produce false long jumps.
OSM relation 4767777 and Pacer linework are shorter and OSM/Pacer descriptions contain Lönnhult/Krokstorp text despite Etapp 4 labels.
Official page notes damp smell after old water damage; a 2025 third-party report describes roof leakage, dampness and mold smell; a 2017 field report was more positive.
Krokstorp has official well/lake-water wording but field reports warn of poor water quality. Mörtfors cabin water is not clearly documented as potable in the gathered sources.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Krokstorp
facilities.description: Shared Etapp 3/4 endpoint cabin with electricity, electric hotplate, simple kitchenware, mattresses, locked access and key in mailbox by the large white house up the hill. Official pages state no fires in fireplaces and no outdoor fires.

facilities.name: Krokstorp tenting at cabin
facilities.description: Maintainer sources list tenting by the cabin with the standard Ostkustleden tent fee. Treat as cabin access metadata rather than an independent campsite unless the app needs tenting records.

facilities.name: Krokstorpssjön swimming
facilities.description: Bathing access near Krokstorpsjön at the Krokstorp start area. Coordinate remains secondary/OSM-derived and should be verified if imported.

facilities.name: Parkering Ölvedal
facilities.description: Mid-stage parking/road access near Ölvedal, useful for planned exit or shuttle access.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Mörtfors
facilities.description: Shelter/rest/fire/info cluster south of Mörtfors, about 0.5 km from the route according to the facilities lane. Useful nearby facility if the import threshold includes this reserve cluster.

facilities.name: Dass Mörtfors south
facilities.description: Dry toilet in the southern Mörtfors reserve/shelter access cluster, about 0.5 km from the route.

facilities.name: Mörtfors badplats
facilities.description: Municipal inland bathing place with grass/sand beach, grill place, swing, changing room, toilet and parking nearby. Bathing-season service is June 1-August 31.

facilities.name: Grillplats Mörtfors badplats
facilities.description: Grill place at Mörtfors badplats. Subject to municipal/county fire-ban status and reserve rules.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga i Mörtfors
facilities.description: Former bathhouse used as Ostkustleden cabin, with kitchen/electric stove, dining/common/wash rooms, five upstairs bedrooms and toilet beside the house. Official page notes damp smell after old water damage; third-party 2025 report raises stronger dampness/mold concern.
